newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial issues $300 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial issues $300 mln in debt.

text.p: The following high-yield debt issue from Olympic Financial Ltd was priced on Friday, according to lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
Olympic Financial purchases, sells and services retail installment contracts for new and used automobiles.
